itemName: Konaseema Chicken Fry Pulao Family Pack
description: Indulge in our Konaseema Chicken Fry Pulao Family Pack, featuring succulent pieces of marinated chicken, perfectly fried and infused with aromatic spices. Nestled in fragrant basmati rice and garnished with fresh herbs, this dish offers a delightful blend of heat and flavor, perfect for sharing with loved ones.
